claims.subject: Enterprise CCaaS
claims.statement: Genesys and Zoom compete for broad contact-center budgets; Converact should integrate or coexist before attempting full-suite replacement.
claims.inference_basis: Their official scope includes broad channel, routing, AI and workforce capabilities beyond the fixed Resolve Pilot.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: CPaaS
claims.statement: Twilio represents a communications API and carrier integration layer that Converact should buy, partner with or wrap rather than treat as Engagement Authority.
claims.inference_basis: The documented product scope is API-based channel execution, while Converact owns cross-channel Engagement, Evidence, Action and Outcome semantics.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: Enterprise AI Agent
claims.statement: Sierra and Decagon compete for enterprise agent automation budgets, so Converact cannot claim differentiation from channels, tools, handoff or framework features alone.
claims.inference_basis: Their official product descriptions already include multiple channels, actions, handoff or governance tooling; Converact differentiation must be tested on the same high-value Resolution flow.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: CRM/FSM
claims.statement: Salesforce and ServiceNow should remain formal Case/WorkOrder Authorities in the initial Overlay Offer.
claims.inference_basis: Their official product scope centers on formal service records and workflows; duplicating them creates a second Authority.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: Visual support vendors
claims.statement: SightCall, TechSee and CareAR are direct Resolve alternatives for visual remote support, but Converact differentiation remains a hypothesis.
claims.inference_basis: Their published capability overlaps no-app/live visual guidance; same-flow buyer win/loss evidence is absent.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: LiveKit
claims.statement: LiveKit is a Room/WebRTC/SFU execution partner or component, not Converact Engagement or telephony business Authority.
claims.inference_basis: LiveKit documents Room/Participant/SFU primitives and SIP bridging, while Converact owns cross-system business continuity.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: Hugging Face speech-to-speech
claims.statement: HF speech-to-speech is a candidate to replace only overlapping SpeechRuntime stages; it is not presumed faster or more accurate.
claims.inference_basis: Both expose overlapping speech loops, but no Converact same-source benchmark exists.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: Active Call
claims.statement: Converact should evaluate only Active Call capabilities that fit a pure PCM and canonical-event adapter, while RustPBX remains the sole SIP, RTP control, Call and telephony billing Authority.
claims.inference_basis: The pinned upstream includes overlapping SIP, WebRTC, media and speech execution as well as useful Playbook and telephony-agent semantics; adopting it wholesale would duplicate Converact Authorities.
required_evidence: same-workload quality, latency, capacity and failure tests
claims.usage_limit: A pinned identity proves only provenance; it does not authorize source absorption or prove Converact performance.

claims.subject: Resolve differentiation
claims.statement: Run auditable same-flow buyer evaluations and win/loss interviews against current phone/video/CRM/FSM alternatives.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: SpeechRuntime candidates
claims.statement: Compare HF, retained LiveKit Agents functions and any pinned Active Call overlap on identical audio, language, hardware, network, turn definitions, quality and total cost.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: RustPBX/rvoip absorption
claims.statement: Evaluate exact low-level slices without creating duplicate SIP, RTP, media or business Authorities.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.

claims.subject: Platform competition
claims.statement: Test whether the horizontal platform wins a defined budget without borrowing Resolve outcomes or feature-count parity.
claims.usage_limit: Does not prove Converact capability, performance, market demand or superiority.
